requirements.text: Before customer data, use a separate private Tigris backup bucket, not a production prefix/directory. Production app credentials cannot access it; only dedicated bucket-scoped backup credentials in the restricted backup execution context do. Actual key delivery/isolation is implementation proof, not assumed from naming a key or adding an env variable.

Before customer data, dated encrypted daily copies have actual DB/byte reference/checksum manifest and explicit seven-day artifact/deletion expiry and cleanup under the restricted backup execution context. Key/control access is recoverable by authorized backup operators; no ordinary app/model/private-care leakage. Lifecycle expiry is not object lock or prevention of earlier privileged deletion; old copy recopy cannot reset subject expiry.

Before customer data, same-provider/account outage/loss may affect both primary storage and backup; disclose accepted limitation and require no second provider as launch gate. Ordinary live-provider 1h RPO/4h RTO remains measured target; daily 24h fallback applies only if a sufficiently fresh successful daily copy survives and remains available; a scheduled job alone does not establish 24h recovery, with no invented disaster RTO/SLA.

Before real customer data, configure/verify selected private backup bucket, dedicated credential exclusion, daily encrypted copies/retention and coherent DB+files restore under current deletion barriers after actual cost approval. Destination no longer needs an owner vote; paid spend/provider setup are not authorized here. Do not install a second-provider resilience blocker or inspect the other worktree.

Request personal deletion only for the authenticated original account; request church-workspace deletion only by its current Owner. Atomically persist subject/request/revision/requestedAt/cancelUntil and suspend affected normal sessions/grants/routes/reads/writes/new signed issuance. Admin cannot delete workspace/another account; no transfer/rejoin engine.

During 30 days retain private affected data and identity proof solely for cancellation, while normal material stays hidden. Restricted native status/cancel authentication for original account or requesting workspace Owner exposes no ordinary content or another subject. Revoked ordinary sessions stay invalid; cancel uses fresh identity/current authority, not restored old tokens.

Cancellation before the deadline and purge claim at/after it use one row-lock/CAS revision/request boundary. Retry returns the recorded result; an old cancel cannot cancel a later request. Cancellation restores only currently valid access and never independently revoked affiliations/roles or another pending account/workspace; no post-deadline cancellation despite late purge worker.

Personal deletion retains independently church-owned People/communication/generated-document history and church-owned native documents with scrubbed minimal attribution; account-owned docs/revisions/avatar/private check-ins follow its private lifecycle. Creator userId is not an ownership classifier. Source NO ACTION FKs need explicit target scrub/rebind, not blind hard delete/cascade.

A workspace request hides its domain records/documents/files/directory/health/sharing contributions for every affected account/org; independent unrelated affiliations/workspaces/org assets remain intact. Original-author private care never transfers to admin/successor/model during cancellation, purge or restore.

Stop obsolete app dispatch and new provider handoffs at pending deletion. Reconcile cancellation of known provider-scheduled mail using existing truthful cancel/sent/unknown races; no instant recall guarantee. Previously issued signed URLs remain bounded by their actual TTL; no new URLs, resend or canceled-send reinstatement on deletion cancellation.

At deadline transition pending→purging and purge eligible live DB/private object content with resumable scope/request fencing. livePurgedAt is recorded only after coherent eligible DB+file purge; failures remain hidden and retryable, not falsely complete. Existing shared-history references remain valid with minimal scrubbed attribution.

behavior_rules.rule: Deletion-only internal purge: actual owner pending-deletion deadline reached/current witness; revoke normal access immediately, coherent bytes/live rows, resumable fence. Not ordinary hard-delete/editor command.

requirements.text: Recovery-copy logical expiry is no later than completed livePurgedAt+7 days and does not create a cancellation right after 30 days. All snapshots/restored branches/object versions/independent backup manifests apply the same subject expiry without clock reset. Restore uses known current deletion witnesses before access; uncertainty fails closed, and expired material is not resurrected.

Privacy policy explains 30 day private cancellation retention/live purge/7 day recovery-copy policy, minimal shared attribution and actual asynchronous provider/external-copy limits. Native own-feedback status also respects suspended/deleted subject filters; no physical day 37-erasure claim or silent public-copy recall.

Verify actual Neon 7 day PITR configuration and daily snapshots before real data; paid default 1 day is insufficient. Expire manual/scheduled/stale/latest-preserved snapshots and restored branches according to selected policy, not indefinite provider defaults. No paid-plan/spend or current provider call is approved.

Verify Tigris 7 day deleted-object recovery and corresponding billing/asynchronous cleanup. Soft-deleted buckets need explicit permanent cleanup; snapshot markers/earlier versions cannot silently retain accessible expired bytes. Native object soft delete is not separate-control disaster backup.

Ordinary mistake restore proves coherent database reference/timepoint plus actual matching private bytes/checksums, including replaced/deleted files and failed upload finalization. Prefer existing immutable keys/references and minimal manifest; daily independent byte backup alone cannot establish 1 hour lost-work target.

Demonstrate ordinary app/operator mistake restore with live provider access within 4 hours and at most 1 hour lost work; record observed results and limitations, not a customer SLA or unproven guarantee. Repeat only for material new changes; before-real-data release gates cannot close on docs/config assertions alone.

Before real customer data, configure/verify selected private backup bucket, dedicated credential exclusion, daily encrypted copies/retention and coherent DB+files restore under current deletion barriers after actual cost approval. Destination no longer needs an owner vote; paid spend/provider setup are not authorized here. Do not install a second-provider resilience blocker or inspect the other worktree. Daily available-copy fallback is 24 hours; no independently hosted provider/account disaster claim or disaster RTO.

Isolated restore reapplies current deletion/access barriers and copy expiry, checks DB/object/manifests and reconciles accepted/scheduled/unknown email and issue receipts before reopening. Old backup recopy cannot restart subject expiry or resend accepted mail/recreate public issues. Verify artifact cleanup before truthful completion; no exact physical day 37 promise.

Only actual account/plant deletion is requestable; its registered purge job binds current request/revision/deadline/claim generation. Deletion request immediately revokes affected normal access and holds privately 30 days solely for restricted native cancellation. DB clock/current request revision fences cancel strictly before deadline and purge at/after. Eligible live DB+bytes purge is resumable/hidden; livePurgedAt only after coherence, copy expiry≤livePurgedAt+7 days without reset. Ownership governs shared minimal attribution; restores apply current witnesses before access and cannot replay canceled mail/expired private bodies.

behavior_rules.rule: Coherent eligible owned DB/byte/cache/derived-copy purge after exact 30-day hold, respecting ownership detach/minimal attribution and current witness.
No post-deadline user cancellation or deleted-subject resurrection; restore always current-witness fenced.
Current recovery/core/execution contract and root selected internal callback encoding; no invented source symbol.
Registered exact internal job/authorized restricted CLI proof, not general user/model approval.
Verify current lifecycle/request/witness/operator and fencing state at each bounded checkpoint.

requirements.text: Verify Neon 7 day PITR+daily expiring snapshots and Tigris 7 day deleted objects. Separate private Tigris backup bucket has dedicated scope and recoverable encryption keys absent ordinary app/build/preview. Same artifact operator-only CLI in a positively identified future restricted scheduled context creates verified dated daily DB+exact-byte/checksum manifests and current witness journal. Ordinary live-provider RPO 1h/RTO 4h is measured; surviving fresh daily fallback≤24h only, shared-provider risk/no disaster RTO/SLA.

behavior_rules.rule: Restore consistent DB+matching bytes with authoritative current deletion/access barrier, immutable copy expiry and actual non-replayed external facts.
